d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav ke natije samne aane ke sath hi rajy men lalu parivar ki aapsi laraee khulkar samne aa gaee hai. shanivar ko rashtriy janta dal (aarjedi) neta aur lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary ne apne parivar se nata torne aur rajniti chhorne ka elan kiya hai. unhonne apne bayan men sanjay yadav ka nam liya hai. aakhir sanjay yadav kaun hain aur vo aarjedi men kitne aham hain?
Riport chandan jajvare
Vidiyoh mukund jha aur adib anvar
